Hi Soojin / Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. Solace is excited to move from pilot to a phased production roll‑out across three clinical units. We want a short, practical MAP (mutual action plan) that lays out the milestones, owners, and go/no‑go gating per unit.

High level asks from our side:
- Clear milestone owners inside Redwood and Solace for each phase
- Acceptance criteria for staging vs production (QA test types + sample sizes)
- A realistic timeline that avoids clinical blackout windows (we prefer weekend activations)
- Contract SOW and procurement checklist (we need this by Nov 6 to hit our Q4 board date)

Can you share a first pass MAP and proposed milestone dates by EOD Tuesday (11/3)? Priyanka on procurement is looped for SOW next steps.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Clinical Ops — Solace Health

Hi Elena / Priyanka —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is a concise first draft of the MAP (PDF) with phase definitions, milestone owners, and proposed target dates. Quick notes up front:

- We broke rollout into Phase A (pilot expansion, nonclinical hours), Phase B (3 clinical pods, weekend cutovers), and Phase C (enterprise-wide onboarding).
- Acceptance criteria are mapped to test types: integration smoke, synthetic traffic run, 48h stability, and a 7‑day clinical shadow before production cutover.
- Owner tags: Ben (Implementation Lead), Soojin (Customer Success Program Owner), Karthik (Platform & SLA lead).

Please review the draft and call out any gating items we missed. We can move dates +/- 7 days if Solace has blackout windows.

Action requested: Elena, can you confirm the preferred weekend windows for Phase B? Priyanka, we'll push a redline SOW by Thursday (11/5) so procurement has time to review.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Elena — thanks for the prompt. Quick inline from my review of the MAP:

- Phase A: suggest we add a preflight data‑ingest checklist (sample size: 10k records) and an ETL reconciliation owner on Solace side (Priyanka / ops?).
- Phase B acceptance: add a 'latency guardrail' checkpoint (95th percentile under 350ms) before shifting to live traffic. We can run a 24‑hour load test in staging to validate.
- Risks: clinical schedule conflicts and data retention approvals (we'll need your internal legal signoff for the retention window).

I can own the integration smoke and the 48h stability runs. Soojin — can you slot the 24‑hour load test for 11/18 (if that weekend works for Solace)?

Ben

Adding platform perspective and owner commitments. Good first pass. A few platform notes and suggested milestone owners/dates:

- Platform readiness: we will reserve a dedicated 2‑GPU test pool for Solace from 11/14–11/20 for load and stability tests. Owner: Karthik Iyer (Platform).
- Feature gating: we recommend a staggered feature flag plan — core inference first (Phase B1), then user‑facing enhancements (B2). Owner: Ben (integration) + Solace eng lead.
- Rollback policy: automated fallback to smaller model variant if latency > 500ms for sustained 5 minutes (we'll document runbooks).

Proposed milestone dates (high‑level):
- Phase A complete: 11/13/2026 (preflight + data ingest)
- Phase B load test (24h): 11/18/2026 — we will run load test and measure latency guardrails
- Phase B stub production cut: 11/21/2026 (weekend window)
- Phase C enterprise rollout: target 12/10/2026

Marissa — looping you for headcount confirmation and SLA acceptance (we may need temporary on‑call overlap). Elena — are these weekend dates acceptable?

Karthik
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
